Turns the always-on service notification into a clock showing 12:45:08 with the date — works on every phone.

Flips the hidden Android “clock seconds” switch, which SystemUI watches live. Needs a one-time ADB grant (no root). Heavily-skinned clocks (OneUI / ColorOS) may ignore this key — if the top-left clock doesn\'t change after granting, use the notification-panel seconds clock above instead.

Connect the phone to a computer and run this once:

adb shell pm grant com.secondsclock android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS

It grants Seconds Clock the ability to change hidden system-UI settings (the same permission SystemUI Tuner apps use). Nothing else changes. Then tap the button again.
Done. If the status-bar clock now ticks seconds your ROM supports it — otherwise it ignores the key and the notification-panel clock is your seconds clock.
Notification clock running — swipe down to see 12:45:08
Or long-press the home screen → Widgets → Seconds Clock
OnePlus/ColorOS: Batteries → Seconds Clock → Allow Auto-launch & Don\'t optimize.\nSamsung/OneUI: Device care → Battery → Background usage limits → add Seconds Clock to Never sleeping apps.
